articles.title: Senate confirms Kevin Warsh to Fed board ahead of expected Chair vote
articles.snippet: Warsh’s confirmation to the Fed board positions the crypto-linked investor to replace Jerome Powell as chair amid inflation and digital asset policy debates.

articles.title: U.S. CFTC in talks with every major pro sports league on policing prediction markets
articles.snippet: Chairman Michael Selig says the agency has already taken several states to court to prove that sports contracts aren't just betting but that they're derivatives.

articles.title: ‘I failed them’: Goliath Ventures CEO charged with crypto Ponzi apologizes
articles.snippet: Christopher Delgado, the former Goliath Ventures CEO charged with fraud and money laundering, has publicly apologized to investors of what US prosecutors allege is a Ponzi scheme.
